title: Noor and the Escarpment
author: Ines Lockridge
blurb: Marguerite Villalobos, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
